\[ \vec{AB} = \langle 2, 2 \rangle \]

\( B\,(3,4,5) \)

Length

\[ \begin{gathered} \left| \vec{v} \right| = \sqrt{2^2 + 2^2} \\[0.5em] = \sqrt{4+4} \\[0.5em] = \sqrt{8} = \sqrt{2 \times 4} \\[0.5em] = 2\sqrt{2} \\[0.5em] \left| \vec{AB} \right| = \left| \langle 2,2,2 \rangle \right| \\[0.5em] = \sqrt{4+4+4} \\[0.5em] = \sqrt{4 \times 3} = 2\sqrt{3} \\[0.5em] \vec{v} = \langle 1, 2, 3 \rangle \\[0.5em] \vec{u} = \langle -1, 0, 1 \rangle \end{gathered} \]

\( \vec{u} - \vec{v} \)

\[ \begin{gathered} = \langle -1-1,\ 0-2,\ 1-3 \rangle \\[0.5em] = \langle -2, -2, -2 \rangle \\[0.5em] \vec{u} + \vec{v} = \langle 1-1,\ 2+0,\ 3+1 \rangle \\[0.5em] = \langle 0, 2, 4 \rangle. \end{gathered} \]

\( 2\vec{u} \)

\[ \vec{u} - \vec{v} = \vec{u} + (-\vec{v}) \]

2.1. Let \( P \) and \( Q \) be the following two points in the 3-space

\[ \begin{cases} P &= (3,-1,4) \\ Q &= (7,2,-5). \end{cases} \]

(i) Find a vector

  1. that has the same direction as the vector \( \vec{PQ} \), and
  2. has length 5.

\( = 5\vec{u} \)

\[ \begin{gathered} \vec{PQ} = \langle 7-3,\ 2+1,\ -5-4 \rangle \\[0.5em] = \langle 4, 3, -9 \rangle \end{gathered} \]

\( \vec{u} \) : the unit vector of the same direction as \( \vec{PQ} \)

\[ \begin{gathered} = \frac{\vec{PQ}}{\left| \vec{PQ} \right|} = \frac{\langle 4, 3, -9 \rangle}{\left| \langle 4, 3, -9 \rangle \right|} \\[0.5em] = \frac{\langle 4, 3, -9 \rangle}{\sqrt{16+9+81}} = \frac{\langle 4, 3, -9 \rangle}{\sqrt{16+90}} \\[0.5em] = \frac{\langle 4, 3, -9 \rangle}{\sqrt{106}} \end{gathered} \]

The vector of the same direction as \( \vec{PQ} \) and has length 5 is

\[ \begin{gathered} \vec{v} = 5\vec{u} = 5 \cdot \frac{\langle 4, 3, -9 \rangle}{\sqrt{106}} \\[0.5em] = \frac{5}{\sqrt{106}} \langle 4, 3, -9 \rangle \\[0.5em] = \left\langle \frac{20}{\sqrt{106}},\ \frac{15}{\sqrt{106}},\ \frac{-45}{\sqrt{106}} \right\rangle . \end{gathered} \]

2.2. A 500lb load hangs from three cables of equal length that are anchored at the points

\[ \begin{cases} B &= (1,-\sqrt{3},0) \\ C &= (1,\sqrt{3},0) \\ D &= (-2,0,0). \end{cases} \]

The load is located at

\[ A = (0,0,-4\sqrt{2}). \]

Find the vector describing the force on the cable anchored at \( B \), i.e., the force the cable is exerting to pull the point \( B \) (resp. C, D) in the direction of the point \( A \).

\( \alpha \vec{BA} = \vec{F_B} \)

\( \beta \vec{CA} = \vec{F_C} \)

\( \vec{F_D} = \gamma \vec{DA} \)

\[ \begin{gathered} -\vec{F_B} - \vec{F_C} - \vec{F_D} + \vec{F} = 0 \\[0.5em] \vec{F} = \langle 0, 0, -500 \rangle \\[0.5em] \begin{cases} B &= (1,-\sqrt{3},0) \\ C &= (1,\sqrt{3},0) \\ D &= (-2,0,0). \end{cases} \\[0.5em] A = (0,0,-4\sqrt{2}). \\[0.5em] \vec{BA} = \langle 0-1,\ 0+\sqrt{3},\ -4\sqrt{2} - 0 \rangle \\[0.5em] = \langle -1, \sqrt{3},\ -4\sqrt{2} \rangle \\[0.5em] \vec{F_B} = \alpha \vec{BA} = \alpha \langle -1, \sqrt{3},\ -4\sqrt{2} \rangle \\[0.5em] \vec{F_C} = \beta \vec{CA} = \beta \langle -1, -\sqrt{3},\ -4\sqrt{2} \rangle \\[0.5em] \vec{F_D} = \gamma \vec{DA} = \gamma \langle 2, 0,\ -4\sqrt{2} \rangle \\[0.5em] \vec{F} = \vec{F_B} + \vec{F_C} + \vec{F_D} \\[0.5em] \langle 0, 0, -500 \rangle = \alpha \langle -1, \sqrt{3},\ -4\sqrt{2} \rangle + \beta \langle -1, -\sqrt{3},\ -4\sqrt{2} \rangle + \gamma \langle 2, 0,\ -4\sqrt{2} \rangle \\[0.5em] \begin{cases} 0 &= -\alpha - \beta + 2\gamma \\ 0 &= \sqrt{3}\alpha - \sqrt{3}\beta \\ -500 &= -4\sqrt{2}\alpha - 4\sqrt{2}\beta - 4\sqrt{2}\gamma \end{cases} \end{gathered} \]

\( \alpha = \beta \)

\[ \begin{gathered} -2\alpha + 2\gamma = 0 \\[0.5em] -\alpha - \alpha + 2\gamma = 0 \end{gathered} \]

\( \alpha = \gamma \)

\[ \begin{gathered} \frac{-500}{-4\sqrt{2}} = \alpha + \beta + \gamma \\[0.5em] \frac{250\sqrt{2}}{4} = \frac{500\sqrt{2}}{4 \times 2} = \alpha + \beta + \gamma \\[0.5em] \frac{250\sqrt{2}}{4} = \alpha + \alpha + \alpha = 3\alpha \\[0.5em] \frac{250\sqrt{2}}{2 \times 2 \times 3} = \alpha \\[0.5em] \frac{125\sqrt{2}}{6} = \alpha = \beta = \gamma \\[0.5em] \vec{F_B} = \alpha \vec{BA} = \frac{125\sqrt{2}}{6} \langle -1, \sqrt{3},\ -4\sqrt{2} \rangle \\[0.5em] \vec{F_C} = \beta \vec{CA} = \frac{125\sqrt{2}}{6} \langle -1, -\sqrt{3},\ -4\sqrt{2} \rangle \\[0.5em] \vec{F_D} = \gamma \vec{DA} = \frac{125\sqrt{2}}{6} \langle 2, 0,\ -4\sqrt{2} \rangle \end{gathered} \]
